sourceChecks.scope: Hockey Canada 'Developing Skilled Defencemen' (2020-21) slide deck. WebFetch's text extraction failed on this PDF (garbled/binary), so it was read directly with the Read tool per the project's PDF-fallback instruction. PDF pages 18-19 are titled 'Shooting' and include 'Get shots through…miss their F. Be able to slide and shoot. Work on fake push, fake pull with movement to avoid F1 in shooting lane' — directly supports exp26-u13-011's premise that a blocker in the direct lane calls for an angle change. The title page carries no LTAD/age-band label (unlike the U13-core-skills doc), so it is used only as a general coaching-principle source, not a U13-specific citation.
